prompt:
Live-action mythic modernism. Photoreal, tactile, cinematic, anamorphic widescreen, 24fps, shallow depth of field. THREE SHOTS, cut in camera at the stated times, and no other coverage. All spoken dialogue is in ENGLISH.

THIS FILM IS THREE SEPARATE INSERT SHOTS FOR AN EDIT. EACH SHOT IS ITS OWN MOMENT ON THE SAME FROZEN PIER, AT A DIFFERENT MOMENT OF THE DAY, WITH ITS OWN PERSON. NOTHING AND NOBODY CARRIES OVER FROM ONE SHOT TO THE NEXT. Each shot holds steady on its subject from its first frame to its last.

THE WORLD OF ALL THREE SHOTS, from @Image1: a low grey pier on a vast frozen brackish lake under a FLAT WHITE OVERCAST SKY of one single value — no sun, no cloud detail, cold 6500K daylight with no shadows. A low sea wall of COARSE DARK GREY SALT-STAINED GRANITE (@Image2) carries a rank of small HORIZONTAL slots, each a hand's width across, with warm amber light deep inside. Everyone's breath is visible in the cold.

REFERENCE PRECEDENCE: @Image3 is the authority for KELL'S COAT SLEEVE AND HAND in Shot 1 only. @Image4 is the authority for the DESTINATION BOARD in Shot 2 only. @Image5 and @Image6 are BEATRICE in Shot 2 only. @Image7 is the authority for YSRA'S FACE, HAIR AND COSTUME in Shot 3 only — not for the table, the veil's position or the frozen hand that also appear in it. @Image8 is Ysra's sheet.

=== SHOT 1 — 0:00 to 0:10 — P1 · CLOSE-UP, 100mm, LOCKED · DAWN · KELL'S HAND ===
NOBODY SPEAKS IN THIS SHOT.

Tight on ONE slot in the dark granite wall. On either side of it, the neighbouring slots glow warm amber. THIS ONE SLOT IS DARK AND COLD INSIDE — the only dark one in the frame. A man's hand is in it — the sleeve of a HEAVY PALE GREY-OATMEAL WOOL OVERCOAT at the wrist, exactly @Image3 — and it comes OUT of the slot into the flat white daylight. ON HIS KNUCKLES THERE IS A FINE FRESH WHITE RIME, and as we watch it grows OUTWARD a little further across the backs of his fingers. He turns the hand over once and holds it still for a moment, looking at it the way a man looks at a card that has been declined. Then he closes it into a fist, and the fist goes down out of the bottom of the frame into his coat pocket. The dark slot stays dark; its neighbours stay warm.
SOUND: flat continuous cold wind, many people breathing nearby, boots on frozen concrete. No music.

CUT at 0:10.

=== SHOT 2 — 0:10 to 0:20 — P2 · CLOSE-UP, 85mm, LOCKED · UNDER THE BOARD · BEATRICE ===
SPOKEN IN THIS SHOT, ONE LINE ONLY:
BEATRICE (flat, procedural, to the board, not to anybody): "And nobody looked up."
AFTER THAT LINE THERE ARE TWO FULL SECONDS OF SILENCE TO THE END OF THE SHOT, AND NOBODY SAYS ANYTHING ELSE.

@Image5 and @Image6 are BEATRICE MORD — a WOMAN in her early forties, dark hair in a TIGHT HIGH TOPKNOT, clean-shaven, in a BLACK ASYMMETRICAL WRAP COAT wrapped and belted across the body over a full-length OXBLOOD-AND-RUST underskirt panel. She has NO cream panel, NO tall collar, NO cuffs, NO ribbon, NO blue, NO rust sash, NO leather chest strap, NO glass cylinders, NO earrings and NO veil.
Close on her face in three-quarter, her whole head inside the frame, LOOKING UP AND OUT OF FRAME at a mechanical destination board above her. Behind her, high and soft, the bone-coloured letters of the board (@Image4) are out of focus against the white sky. Cold flat key. HER BREATH IS VISIBLE. She says her four words to the board, at the emotional volume of a delayed connection, and then simply keeps looking up. Her face does not change.
SOUND: wind; forty people breathing behind her; nothing else.

CUT at 0:20.

=== SHOT 3 — 0:20 to 0:30 — P3 · MEDIUM, 50mm, VERY SLOW PUSH · LATE MORNING · YSRA BOARDS LAST ===
NOBODY SPEAKS IN THIS SHOT.

AMBASSADOR YSRA SABLE — a BLACK WOMAN IN HER LATE FIFTIES with a lean angular face, high cheekbones and a firm jaw; THICK SCULPTURAL BRAIDS streaked with grey wound into a RAISED BRAIDED CROWN; LONG THIN DARK DROP EARRINGS hanging to the jaw on both sides; a floor-length high-necked CHARCOAL-BLACK gown with a smooth funnel neck under a wide dark overrobe of OVERLAPPING FLAT RECTANGULAR PANELS, a WIDE COBALT-BLUE PANEL running the full height of the skirt at one side, and LONG DARK GLOVES. HER HEAD IS BARE: the coiled black ring of her veil is NOT on her head; her braided crown is plainly uncovered, with a ring-shaped dent pressed into it where the veil sat for eleven years. SHE CARRIES THE VEIL IN HER LEFT GLOVED HAND, down at her side, the way a person carries a hat they have taken off: a heavy flat coil of many layered matte black bands, about the size of a dinner plate. It does not glow and does not float.
She stands alone at the foot of the step of an open carriage door at FRAME RIGHT; the door shows the WARM AMBER-LIT WALNUT INTERIOR of the carriage. Everyone else has boarded. SHE TURNS HER HEAD AND LOOKS BACK DOWN THE PIER, past the lens at frame left, for a long moment. Her face is UNMANAGED — composed and completely exposed at once, dry-eyed, carrying something heavy. Then she turns and STEPS UP INTO THE DOORWAY, and AS SHE CROSSES THE THRESHOLD HER FACE CHANGES FROM COLD BLUE-WHITE DAYLIGHT TO WARM AMBER LAMPLIGHT. She does not look back again. THE MOVE: a very slow continuous push toward the door, still moving at the cut.
SOUND: wind; a step plate; the faint warm murmur of the carriage interior, indistinct. No music.

PALETTE: ice white #EEF3F5, brine grey #7E8A90, slot amber #A9721F, coat soot #2C2A27, veil black #101215, cobalt #1E2A5A.

FROST GROWS OUTWARD FROM BODIES AND NEVER INWARD FROM ANYTHING: it starts on a person's skin or clothes and its fine needles spread AWAY from them. The stone, the windows and the air never frost. Nothing glows anywhere except the faint amber inside the slots and the carriage lamps. No machinery, no gears, no runes, no magical light, no lens flare, no particles, no smoke, no digital element, no screens, no interface, no signage, no ornament, and no Victorian, Edwardian, medieval or steampunk detail.
